description: Dependency updates (phase-11 §11.6, #116). Weekly, grouped; security fixes at once.
Nothing is merged automatically: only some CI jobs are required yet (§11.7).
OpenCloud legs, the web SDK and the CS3 APIs are the compatibility risk (compatibility-policy §4): never automerged, ever.
Versions in workflows, the Makefile and scripts are found through a `# renovate:` line above them (internal/buildinfo/renovate_test.go).

customManagers.description: Annotated versions: `# renovate: datasource=… depName=… [extractVersion=…]` above `NAME: "1.2.3"`, `NAME ?= 1.2.3` or `NAME=1.2.3`.
Annotated images: `# renovate: datasource=docker` above `NAME ?= image:tag@sha256:…`.
The Garage image the integration tests start.
The OpenCloud legs CI tests against, by tag and index digest. The canary has no digest and is not matched.

packageRules.description: Supply chain: a version must have been public for three days, so a hijacked release is usually withdrawn before it is proposed. Not for security fixes (vulnerabilityAlerts).
The go directive is the minimum for `go install` users; it moves on purpose, not with every bump.
One Go toolchain everywhere: go.mod's toolchain, the images' build stage, every workflow (TestToolchainIsTheSameEverywhere).
One Node everywhere: the workflows and the web image's build stage.
Go modules, minor and patch, in one weekly pull request. kopia (repository format, data crypto) and the CS3 APIs get their own.
The web extension's dependencies, minor and patch, in one weekly pull request.
GitHub Actions, in one weekly pull request, pinned by commit.
Build, release and scanning tools pinned in workflows, the Makefile and scripts.
The images' base images (the build stages follow the toolchain groups).
This project's own images in deploy/: the bump after a release (#110). check-deploy-images.sh refuses anything unpublished.
OpenCloud: every release may change CS3, which is not a public interface (compatibility-policy §4). Never automerged; a bump updates README's supported range and the policy's table too.
prBodyNotes: **OpenCloud leg.** Never merged automatically (compatibility-policy.md §4). Update README's supported sentence (`TestREADMESupportedSentence`) and the policy's version table in this pull request, and check the whole matrix.

packageRules.description: oldest: the first release of the previous major. It moves with a new major, by hand (compatibility-policy §3); only a re-pushed digest is proposed.
previous-major: the newest minor of the previous major; a new major moves it by hand.
production: the newest patch of the current Production line; a new line moves it by hand.
OpenCloud's web packages and the CS3 APIs follow OpenCloud: their own pull request, never automerged.
